source: docs/research/experiment.md (Herrmann et al. 2024, Shadish-Cook-Campbell validity, ML methodology critiques)

claim_type.q: What kind of claim does the experiment test?

labels.comparative-performance: ours is better than / matches / not worse than baselines
labels.data-efficiency: needs less data or fewer samples/labels/interactions
labels.compute-efficiency: needs less compute, memory, latency or steps
labels.parameter-efficiency: needs fewer parameters or trainable weights
labels.scaling: how behaviour changes with scale; a functional form or extrapolation
labels.generalization-ood: holds under distribution shift, new domains or tasks
labels.robustness: holds under noise, corruption, attack; stability across seeds/hyperparameters
labels.attribution: a specific component, choice or ingredient causes the effect
labels.mechanism: how or why something works internally (representations, dynamics, circuits)
labels.theory-validation: an empirical check of a theoretical prediction or assumption
labels.phenomenon: an exploratory observation or characterization of a behaviour
labels.negative: something does not help, fails, or a prior claim does not hold
labels.safety-fairness-privacy: safety, alignment, fairness or privacy properties
labels.human-perceived-quality: people prefer or judge the output better

labels.ablation: remove, replace or add one component at a time
labels.hyperparameter-sweep: vary a hyperparameter or design choice
labels.scale-sweep: vary model size, data size, compute, steps or inference budget
labels.data-manipulation: shift, corrupt, subsample, relabel or contaminate data
labels.synthetic-setting: a controlled synthetic or toy task with known ground truth
labels.internal-intervention: probe, patch, freeze, steer or lesion model internals
labels.budget-matched: compare under a matched budget (FLOPs, time, tokens, tuning trials)
labels.human-evaluation: a human or expert rating protocol

labels.visualization: attention, embedding, attribution or internal visualization
labels.theory-overlay: empirical results overlaid on a theoretical prediction

role.q: What role does the experiment play in the paper?
